name: Passion projects
summary: What members built across the 50 days. The member's description, milestones and dates from the submission only.
slide_pattern: photo-top (the finished artefact) → project-timeline (3–5 milestones with dates) → statement (the member's words) → cta
extra_voice_rules: The member's own description. The submission is the source of truth.
Milestones and dates from the submission only. Never invented.
Day markers drawn like the site's 50-day grid (small numerals, not a calendar).
One finished thing is the through-line. Use that phrase from the first slide.
extra_checks: Every milestone date in the post equals a milestone date in the submission.
The finished artefact is the same as in the submission's photo evidence.
No 'I built this in 50 days' if the submission's timeline doesn't support it.
